title: DMPNN Performance Estimates Diverge across Evaluation Boundaries in a Cyclic-Peptide Permeability Benchmark
description: Release-safe curation and split manifests, aggregate source data, reporting code and reproducibility records for a cyclic-peptide PAMPA benchmark. The archive excludes third-party row-level structures and permeability labels while redistribution permissions remain unconfirmed.
